skill_name: Explain how artificial intelligence is transforming the healthcare field
workflow: Artificial intelligence has been increasingly integrated into modern healthcare in order to improve patient outcomes, reduce costs and improve efficiency. AI is being used to develop tools such as virtual health assistants, automated diagnosis and AI-augmented imaging analysis, which can better detect and classify medical conditions.
